health_daily_active_method.expression: 24h formula BMR + Apple Health day-to-date activeEnergyBurned - estimated logged food kcal
health_daily_active_method.interpretation: Secondary alternative comparison ONLY, not the user's ongoing model, do not headline or record as the daily default deficit. May be sensitive to incomplete day sync; must not combine with workout energy.

existing_tdee_v1_scenarios.expression: BMR×1.2 + session active calories×0.75 - food; session active calories not independently verified
existing_tdee_v1_scenarios.interpretation: These are two modeling assumptions, not a measured interval or confidence interval. Cannot populate primary completed_day_estimated_deficit_kcal without confirmed single-session active calories plus formal coverage checks.

calorie_balance_review.further_caveats: Device active energy and food kcal are both estimates; 1734 kcal is only synced basal for the not-yet-ended calendar day and is not a separate amount to add to 24h BMR. Historic formula-based BMR and device basal energy are different methods. 619.31 kcal workout energy is already part of device day activity and must not be double counted. User reconfirmed original 75% workout discount model as sole main reporting convention; previous headline ~353 kcal came from a different method and is not directly comparable. Standard completed_day_estimated_deficit_kcal remains null due to missing verified session-active kcal and partial food coverage, but supplemental display estimate ~284 kcal can be shown with assumption.
calorie_balance_review.preferred_method_reason: 用户原方案固定使用BMR×1.2＋单次运动动态千卡×0.75−摄入。禁止默认改为公式BMR+全天Health动态能量，也不得把两种算法的缺口混入同一纵向趋势。

user_facing_daily_deficit_estimate.workout_active_energy_assumption: 619.31kcal workout totalEnergy is temporarily proxied as session active (not confirmed); this is an assumed training active kcal for a display-only estimate, not a verified active_kcal measurement or an instruction to override exercise_entries.
user_facing_daily_deficit_estimate.uncertainty: If raw workout energy includes resting portion during 58m29s, estimate 74.25kcal resting then ~228.03 kcal deficit. The two scenarios are not an empirical interval; neither is fully validated.
